```sql
SELECT p.team_id, COUNT(c.member_id) AS member_count
FROM teams AS p
LEFT JOIN members AS c ON c.team_id = p.team_id
GROUP BY p.team_id;
```
使用`LEFT JOIN`保留父表记录，并统计子表非空主键，空组才能得到0。

SELECT p.warehouse_id, COUNT(c.stock_id) AS stock_count
FROM warehouses AS p

    items.append(x)
